h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Tyler, Texas with Defensive Driving: Every Smith County Court, Fees and Rules

faqs.q: How do I dismiss a traffic ticket in Tyler, Texas?
faqs.a: Request a driving safety course from the court on your citation on or before the appearance date, pay the court\

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Tyler or Smith County?
faqs.a: Smith County justice courts charge a $146 court fee; Whitehouse charges $144; Tyler Municipal Court charges court costs plus $10. Add the course ($28 with the certificate included at Road Ready Safety) and, where required, the $12 DPS driving record. Roughly $150 to $190 total.

faqs.q: Which court has my Tyler ticket?
faqs.a: Read the court name on the citation. A City of Tyler police officer\

faqs.q: Can I take the defensive driving course online for a Tyler ticket?
faqs.a: Yes. Every court in Smith County accepts a TDLR-approved online course, including Tyler Municipal Court and all five JP precincts. You must get the court\

faqs.q: Do Smith County courts require the Type 3A driving record?
faqs.a: Several do. JP Precincts 3 and 5 require the official DPS driving record, and Noonday, Arp, Troup and Winona require the certified Type 3A record with the certificate. Tyler Municipal Court asks for a copy of your DPS driving record. Order it online from DPS for $12 as an instant PDF.

faqs.q: How long do I have after a Tyler court approves the course?
faqs.a: 90 days under Texas law. JP Precinct 3 also requires the request itself to be postmarked by the citation due date, and Precinct 5 states the certificate must arrive within the 90-day window, so treat the court\

courts.name: Tyler Municipal Court
courts.note: City of Tyler police tickets. Request in person, by mail, or through the court\

courts.name: Smith County JP Precinct 1 (Tyler, Ferguson St.)
courts.note: Deputy and DPS tickets in central Tyler. $146 court fee. Submit the signed Driving Safety Course Request Form, proof of insurance, a copy of your license, and the fee by the citation due date.

courts.name: Smith County JP Precinct 2 (Hwy 155 S, Tyler)
courts.note: $146 fee. Signed request form, proof of insurance, copy of license, payment. South Tyler and the Hwy 155 corridor.

courts.name: Smith County JP Precinct 3 (Troup)
courts.note: $146 fee. The request form with fee and proof of insurance must be postmarked by the citation due date. Requires the official DPS driving record and an affidavit that no course was in progress or completed in the prior 12 months.

courts.name: Smith County JP Precinct 4 (Winona)
courts.note: $146 fee. Proof of insurance and a copy of your license with the fee. Northern Smith County.

courts.name: Smith County JP Precinct 5 (Lindale)
courts.note: $146 fee. Request form, proof of insurance on the offense date, copy of license, the certificate within 90 days, the official DPS driving record, and a 12-month affidavit.

courts.name: Whitehouse Municipal Court
courts.note: $144 fee. Requests in person; bring your Texas license and insurance showing you as a covered driver. Certificate after the course.

courts.name: Lindale Municipal Court
courts.note: Requests in person or through the city\

courts.name: Noonday Municipal Court
courts.note: Call the court to request. Requires a certified Type 3A driving record from DPS with the certificate.

courts.name: Arp Municipal Court
courts.note: Request by phone or in person. Type 3A driving record required with the certificate.

courts.name: Troup Municipal Court
courts.note: Request by phone, in person, or by mail. Type 3A driving record required.

courts.name: Winona Municipal Court
courts.note: Request by phone or in person. Type 3A driving record typically required; confirm with the court.
